# Toward workforce pathways into the semiconductor manufacturing sector

## Specific Aims

Aim 1: Advance workforce pathways into the semiconductor manufacturing sector via a population-focused strategy.
Aim 2: Advance workforce pathways into the semiconductor manufacturing sector via a population-focused strategy.

## Background

Our preliminary data suggest a tractable path toward measurable improvement. Findings will be disseminated through peer-reviewed publication and open data release. Rigorous, pre-registered analyses will guard against bias and support reproducibility. This proposal addresses workforce pathways into the semiconductor manufacturing sector, a problem with substantial significance.

## Approach

This proposal addresses workforce pathways into the semiconductor manufacturing sector, a problem with substantial significance.
